findings.issue: The immutable addresses read as 0, so the vat/pot/susds/conv calls target 0x0 (and some lose their names through P2).

notes: The only source loop, set()'s for over updates (191), is shown as a readable while: out-of-order check, Cfg checks (rate-not-configured, below-min, above-max), the DSR/SSR/ilk branches with the gap check, and the file calls. The Cfg struct is copied to memory (mem[_91..+64] = its three uint16 fields) although the checks read storage directly (dead writes, P8/P18), and updates[i].id / .bps print as cd[64 * idx + _param1 + 36] / + 68 (P16). The file() setters, the auth functions and getters were read; faithful.
summary: Faithful, readable text with its single source loop found; immutables make the external rate calls target 0x0, and calldata struct members stay raw offsets.
